result.rationale: The feed_key method is indeed defined and never called, but the claimed harm — 'all items reimported hourly' — is contradicted by the diff itself: TopicEmbed.import looks up an existing embed by embed_url ('embed = TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first') and only revises the post when 'content_sha1 != embed.content_sha1'. So unchanged items are not reimported; the only residual issue is a dead helper method plus skipping a conditional GET, which is a style/efficiency nit, not the described defect.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`, `feed_key` is indeed defined and never referenced anywhere in this diff, so it is dead/unused code. However, the finding’s causal claim that this results in “all items reimported hourly” is not strictly supported: the job is intentionally scheduled `hourly`, and each item is passed through `TopicEmbed.import`, which deduplicates by `embed_url` and only revises when `content_sha1` changes. There is also no evidence in the diff that `feed_key` was intended for conditional GET or that its absence is a correctness bug (it’s more an optimization/cleanup opportunity).
